This proposal advocates for the explicit inclusion of continuous fuzzing practices (I don't mean DAST), particularly coverage-based fuzzing, within Continuous Deployment (CD) pipelines in the ASVS.

Fuzzing, especially automated fuzzing in CD pipelines, has proven instrumental in identifying and resolving security vulnerabilities that may not be detected by other testing methods. For example I found this bug in Python's pickle module ([Issue 41288](https://bugs.python.org/issue41288)), and I used the AFL fuzzer to find this in a few hours and this bug could lead to denial-of-service (DoS). 

This demonstrates the necessity for coverage-based fuzzing to be part of the standard security testing toolkit in modern development pipelines.
